text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days after the intensity of the Japanese Derby, Mejiro Ardan receives some bad news.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She learns that Sakura Chiyono O, who she ran alongside, is to be hospitalized due to a serious injury, and she won't be racing for the time being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: This should be just about everything you'll need at the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Ardan… You should be training but you're here helping me…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, come on now, you needn't feel guilty. You did just the same for me whenever I was hospitalized or discharged.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It's only natural that I should be here for you too. If we've shared a roof, we ought to be able to share our troubles as well… don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ardan…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Would you like to get some fresh air with me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That sounds nice, but wouldn't that worsen your condition?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll be fine! I was told not to run, but I'm allowed to walk as long as I take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Also… I want to take a look around the academy since I won't be coming back here for some time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Understandable. Let's go for a walk then, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I wonder when I'll get to run on this track again…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. We finally ran the Japanese Derby, and though it wasn't long ago, it feels almost like a dream now…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, it wasn't a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: It was a very, very special race… one in which you, Yaeno Muteki, and I all pitted all we had against one another.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yes… You're right.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It was a once-in-a-lifetime race… full of memories…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: To think that I was able to run that race with both you and Yaeno that day…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm just… so glad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Oh no! It's almost time for me to leave!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh dear! Let's hurry back and pick up your belongings.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Well… I should get going.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Right… Do take care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And also…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I hope we can run again, together, in a race even more magnificent than the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall be waiting for you on the turf, Chiyono O… as your rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best! I won't let this be the end!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to run with you and Yaeno even more… So!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I swear that someday… I'll make my comeback! Until then, wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Of course. …I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay… I'll be off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (…You can do it, Chiyono O. I just know you've got what it takes to get through this and return to racing.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Just as you were there for me, it's now my turn to be there for you. So I'll be there, waiting for you…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Has Chiyono O departed?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, she left a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I was shocked at how you and Chiyono O ran in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Or rather, if I may be candid… it would not be inaccurate to say that I was thunderstruck.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The sheer determination the two of you displayed in that fleeting instant… The way you ran with unbound spirit… These sights remain vivid in my mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was reminded once again… that you are both unmistakably worthy opponents.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Thus, I have made up my mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: When the time comes, I will run against and best you both in a direct contest. I swear it…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As an archrival… to both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (Yaeno… So she believes as well!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (She believes that Chiyono O will race with us again…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …I welcome the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I, too, shall run with all my heart against you and Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …As your rival!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan is with me in my office, recounting everything that happened today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And when she finishes talking, I see in her eyes a light of fierce determination that's brighter than ever before!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …A newfound feeling stirs within me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Until now, all my intense training and racing has been in an effort to leave a dazzling trail of light behind me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But the person I am right now seeks more than that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno considers me her rival, and for her, I wish to do myself proud.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I wish to reach the same level as Chiyono O, whom I've no doubt at all will return to racing one day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I can feel these wishes deep down, burning with the intensity of a raging inferno.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Trainer. May I ask you to show me the way?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: To a stage upon which I can aim for even greater heights, as a rival to both Yaeno and Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In my mind, I can envision two futures that satisfy her request.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first would see her participate in the final race of the Triple Crown tour—the long-distance Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, who fully considers Mejiro Ardan her rival, will likely be making an appearance at the Kikuka Sho as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I did make Mejiro Ardan race in a long-distance race like that, I'd effectively be forcing her into an uphill battle…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That being said, if I put Mejiro Ardan—as she is right now—up against Yaeno Muteki again, their clash could reveal a path to greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The second future would entail Mejiro Ardan making an appearance at the autumn Tenno Sho, a prestigious medium-distance race dominated by top senior-year racers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And if my predictions are right, two particular runners—whose names are known to every racer of this era—will be attending the race too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "The Beast" Oguri Cap… and Tamamo Cross, "the White Lightning."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is a prodigy from the countryside who rose to the top ranks by achieving a miraculous streak of wins after her debut. Right now, her incredible talents are the focus of a great deal of attention.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As fate would have it, she's in the same year as Mejiro Ardan, so perhaps they were bound to compete against one another sooner or later.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then there's Tamamo Cross, who managed a ludicrous series of victories during her senior year. She's hailed as the number one in the country and—in this moment—the pinnacle of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Ardan hoping to cast an unfading trail of light upon the present itself, there's definitely a lot she could learn from racing such a trailblazing opponent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A battle against two giant stars who have made waves across their generation might just show her a new world of possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Mejiro Ardan's trainer, the future I'm going to show her is…
choice_data_list: Let's enter the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The goal race is now the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …The Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My battle will be against Yaeno once more, I see.
choice_data_list: It's going to be a tough race.
It's going to be a tough race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, it will be. But I knew it would be.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have chosen "the steepest, most strenuous path of all." And the moment in which I can truly shine is found in the heat of such fierce battles.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. I wonder what will happen during our race. Just thinking about it makes my heart soar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Starting with tomorrow's training… I'll be counting on you once again, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having set our sights on the Kikuka Sho, we solemnly swear—with the night sky as our witness—to push ahead toward our next battle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The goal race is now the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …The autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: So that race is to be the site of my next battle—against the runners hailed as the greatest of this moment.
